name: eds-migration-toolkit
description: Crawl a legacy site, scrape its content/styles/assets, classify sections against the EDS block library, and generate ready-to-author Word documents (block tables) for an Edge Delivery Services migration.

scripts.test:fixture: node bin/migrate.js classify --input fixtures/sample-site --output output/fixture-test && node bin/migrate.js generate --input output/fixture-test --output output/fixture-test
